$comment: Common shape every collector produces (docs/04 §2.4-§5). Author/user fields are intentionally absent (privacy rule R2). Media is never fetched; only media_present is kept (R1).

content_hash.description: sha256(normalized text: lowercased, whitespace-collapsed, URLs removed)

url.description: Canonical public permalink to the post/comment/article. Never a profile URL.

platform_post_id.description: Platform's id for the post/comment; hashed before storage in signals.post_id_hash

published_at.description: UTC ISO 8601. Items without a reliable publish time are discarded before this object is created.

text.description: Title + body/caption or comment body, with @handles, emails, phone numbers and URLs replaced by [handle]/[email]/[phone]/[link]. Max 6,000 chars.

query.description: The planned query that found this item

source_scope.description: li_scoped = LI subreddit or LI news domain

platform_place_tag.description: Name of a platform geotag if present (never coordinates)

parent_title.description: For comments: the thread title, for context
